subject: rstan: formatting data for multi-dimensional vectors/row_vectors?

messages.author: dae01c57a3c54a3a
messages.subject: rstan: formatting data for multi-dimensional vectors/row_vectors?
parts:
Hopefuly a quick'un! Lots of examples have data variables defined as

    vector[D] x[N];

or 

    row_vector[D] x[N];

But I haven't seen any examples of how to actually format the data for these variables in R to pass to the expected named list for the "data" argument to rstan::sampling(). Help?

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] rstan: formatting data for multi-dimensional vectors/row_vectors?
parts:
There's doc in the CmdStan manual, but it probably didn't make
it into R's doc.

It's just a rectangular data structure for the shape. all of
the following are M x N:

matrix[M, N] a;
vector[N] a[M];
row_vector[N] a[M];
real a[M, N];

The array indices are picked up first, then the underlying types.
That's because

vector[N] a[M];

is declaring a to be an M-array of N-vectors. So you have to
index into the array to get the vector.

- Bob
